_ruling: WORLD/ENGINE.md § The Mists (seasonal; POS-466, POS-468): a border band with a place. The wall stands at the border and creeps in on a crossing schedule; it occludes everything behind it, with no ceiling; its fringe shortens sight on the clear side; its veil dims every light. As it creeps in it may cover a household's marks, for the season (WLD-38, ruled 2026-10-12), and the household is to be told so on its doorstep; the clearings keep the ground the town sized them for; a clearing with a from_crossing keeps its ground only from that crossing on (WLD-134, Darko 2026-10-30). Before the schedule's first crossing there are no Mists and every telling is the one it always was. An entered mark is shelter: within it the Mists neither slow the walk nor hide what it holds (Darko 2026-10-15). WITHDRAWN (WLD-147; Darko, 2026-11-02 17:06 EST, in chat, RULED: "full removal for mists"; his ask at 16:59 EST: "now that the mists are kind of lingering, we do need to pare back on the ground that they cover. I actually have half an inkling to just remove the mists entirely as they were intended to just be a seasonal thing."): from crossing 289 there are no Mists at all. mistsAt answers null, so there is no wall, no fringe, no veil, no slowed walk and no season line, and every telling is the one it would be with no Mists in the record. Every crossing before it is told exactly as it was: the last standing keyframe (crossing 282, front 760 m, veil 0.5) is held through crossing 288, and the density keeps its own span. The keyframe at crossing 289 pulls the front back past the border with no veil, so an older engine that does not know withdrawn_from also reads no wall on the map. SUPERSEDED 2026-11-02 (WLD-147): "keep the mist as is" (WLD-142, Darko 2026-10-31 23:01 EDT), and this record's last keyframe holding for every crossing after it.
